mostWorthwhile.text: Following recovered iron into new red blood cells was most worthwhile: it connected recycling to the oxygen-carrying protein.

leastWorthwhile.text: Growing skin cells was the least engaging choice because it was the only combination left, though its result clearly showed replacement.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the recovered iron to travel attached to proteins rather than as metal fragments.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; both pairings followed the stated goals and pictures.

continue.text: I would probably continue: seeing old cell materials reused and skin renewed made me curious about other ways the body maintains itself, although the choices were fairly guided.
